presets.name: Classic chorus
presets.description: Two voices on a triangle, the synth chorus of the early 80s.

presets.name: Subtle width
presets.description: Slow and shallow: a little width and life for anything.

presets.name: Deep chorus
presets.description: Slow, deep and wide, for pads.

presets.name: Guitar chorus
presets.description: A clear, shimmering chorus for clean guitar.

presets.name: Bass chorus
presets.description: Chorus above 250 Hz only, so the low end stays solid and centred.

presets.name: Vocal thickener
presets.description: Two close voices that thicken without wobbling.

presets.name: Mono-safe chorus
presets.description: Both sides move together, so it sums to mono without losing anything.

presets.name: String ensemble
presets.description: Three voices with the quick shimmer, for string machines and pads.

presets.name: Ensemble wash
presets.description: Deep ensemble with some feedback: a wide, swirling wash.

presets.name: Warm ensemble
presets.description: Ensemble with Warmth, darker and softer, for electric pianos.

presets.name: Lead vibrato
presets.description: A natural vibrato for a synth lead, both sides together.

presets.name: Wide vibrato
presets.description: The sides bending in opposite directions: vibrato that also spreads.

presets.name: Siren
presets.description: A deep triangle vibrato that swaps between two pitches.

presets.name: Metallic
presets.description: Short voices with inverted feedback: a hollow, ringing edge.
